integrity: The formulas are proved from the primitive cycle dependence, lattice index, fundamental parallelepiped heights, and unimodular circuit triangulations. Directly relevant full texts were compared at statement level; a residual risk remains of an unstated equivalent special case in broader lattice-circuit literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a single cycle. It does not classify h*-polynomials for arbitrary unicyclic or general non-semi-balanced digraphs. Finite verification through cycle length eight is only a cross-check of the analytic proof.
title: Exact Ehrhart polynomials of oriented cycle root polytopes
